title: Coin Change: best answer for every smaller amount

steps.caption: Coin Change: dp[a] = fewest coins that make amount a. dp[0] = 0; everything else starts as ∞ (unknown).
Amount 1: try every coin as the LAST coin and take the best. dp[1] = 1 (last coin 1).
Amount 2: try every coin as the LAST coin and take the best. dp[2] = 2 (last coin 1).
Amount 3: try every coin as the LAST coin and take the best. dp[3] = 1 (last coin 3).
Amount 4: try every coin as the LAST coin and take the best. dp[4] = 1 (last coin 4).
Amount 5: try every coin as the LAST coin and take the best. dp[5] = 2 (last coin 1).
Amount 6: try every coin as the LAST coin and take the best. dp[6] = 2 (last coin 3).
dp[6] = 2 (3 + 3), where greedy would say 3 (4 + 1 + 1). O(amount × coins) time, O(amount) space.
